summary: Comprehensive testing of ClearFile NG (renamed from NairaTrack) with 6 new major features. Backend API testing achieved 100% success rate (19/19 tests passed). Frontend testing validated all new features: State vs Federal Tax Routing, TCC Tracker, Tax Planner, AI Smart Categorizer with deductible badges, Trust Signals, and updated onboarding with salary_earner option.
